roleTemplateAssignmentPolicy: Role templates are examples; multiple templates per person permitted but approval separation checked per transaction; templates never automatically bypass domain policy.

AP-PLAT-ONBOARD.required: Verified business onboarding request, MFA; first owner invitation and recipient acceptance
AP-PLAT-ONBOARD.separation: Provisioning operator cannot self-assign to tenant

AP-PLAT-RECOVERY.required: Independently verified company evidence, two distinct approvers and audited recovery

AP-TEN-DELEGATION.required: Owner/delegated admin within grantable scope; verified invitation and accepted membership
AP-TEN-DELEGATION.separation: No self elevation or last-owner removal

AP-COM-ISSUE.required: Valid exact quote version, allowed amount/terms; exceptional cases require prior approval

AP-COM-EXCEPTION.required: Independent authorized approver, limit/currency/legal entity, matching quote version
AP-COM-EXCEPTION.separation: Requester != approver for the approval instance

AP-COM-CUSTOMER-ACCEPT.required: Verified customer signatory, accepted exact current version, explicit terms evidence
AP-COM-CUSTOMER-ACCEPT.separation: Provider's employee cannot accept for customer merely by role

AP-COM-PROCUREMENT.required: Carrier offer verified, partner permission and allowed procurement scope
AP-COM-PROCUREMENT.separation: Carrier cannot select itself as buyer without delegated provider rights

AP-BOOKING.required: Accepted customer terms + confirmed exclusive reservation + approved cargo/compliance state

AP-POD.required: Authorized receiver, cargo-unit evidence and signed/verified delivery outcome
AP-POD.separation: Driver cannot assert receiver confirmation without evidence

AP-FINANCE.required: Independent payment approver, authority amount, legal entity, verified obligation/payment reference

AP-CUSTOMER-REVIEW.required: Execution source verified completion, customer relationship, one eligible review per service
AP-CUSTOMER-REVIEW.separation: Provider staff cannot pose as customer or alter review

AP-JOB-REPLAY.required: Authorized replay request, redacted diagnostics, attempt audit and dedup
AP-JOB-REPLAY.separation: No tenant data browsing or silent impersonation

AP-SCOPED-READ.required: Active identity and exact resource scope, allowlisted fields, relevant grant
AP-SCOPED-READ.separation: No human approval; must still authorize each read

AP-CUSTOMER-RELATION.required: Verified customer organization and provider relationship, account membership/invitation

AP-RFQ.required: Authorized submitter, correct customer/provider scope and RFQ lifecycle state
AP-RFQ.separation: No quote or booking implied by RFQ

AP-COM-DRAFT.required: Assigned Sales/Expeditor, legal entity, quote in draft state and policy

AP-FLEET-RESERVATION.required: Vehicle/time ownership, authoritative capacity state and carrier consent

AP-CUSTODY.required: Driver assignment and actual cargo unit handover evidence
AP-CUSTODY.separation: Trip started or GPS alone never implies pickup

AP-TRIP.required: Authorized dispatcher, assigned booking/driver and valid resource state

AP-DOCUMENT.required: Exact package/document, tenant/customer grants, evidence verification, time-limited access
AP-DOCUMENT.separation: No blanket document read via account role

AP-FINANCE-PREP.required: Own legal entity, verified obligation/accounting reference and correct state
AP-FINANCE-PREP.separation: Preparation never implies approval or verified payment

AP-PLATFORM-OBS.required: Read-only redacted job metadata, incident/operational purpose and audit

AP-COM-MARGIN.required: Explicit margin-read financial permission and own legal entity

AP-QUOTE-DECLINE.required: Customer authorization on exact current QuoteVersion and declinable state; idempotent command and reason audit
AP-QUOTE-DECLINE.separation: Read permission alone never permits quote decline

AP-RFQ-ASSIGN.required: Provider team/branch scope for unassigned RFQ, atomic assignee change with expectedVersion, audit
AP-RFQ-ASSIGN.separation: Read-only inbox roles cannot assign; no foreign branch takeover

AP-BOOKING-CANCEL-REQUEST.required: Customer Account scope, exact booking and open cancellation-request eligibility; persisted request with reason; no automatic cancel
AP-BOOKING-CANCEL-REQUEST.separation: Dispatcher/contract authority must decide cancellation and costs independently

AP-CUSTOMER-ISSUE.owner: Commercial intake -> owning Execution/Booking issue handling
AP-CUSTOMER-ISSUE.required: Requester has exact customer order/Booking, issue type and evidence; clear escalation owner; not a review or POD rewrite
AP-CUSTOMER-ISSUE.separation: Issue submission does not automatically approve refunds or change shipment state

AP-FINANCE-RECONCILE.required: Approved Finance permission, source-verified bank/ERP transaction reference, unique allocation, amounts/currency and immutable audit
AP-FINANCE-RECONCILE.separation: Human approval is not bank settlement and does not automatically set Paid

AP-CUSTOMER-SELF-REVOKE.required: Verified EXC user and exact own provider CustomerAccount membership; revoke own sessions/tokens
AP-CUSTOMER-SELF-REVOKE.separation: No deletion or global suspension of customer organization and other members

AP-CUSTOMER-RELATION-SUSPEND.required: Authorized provider manager/Owner, verified business basis, notice and safe retention
AP-CUSTOMER-RELATION-SUSPEND.separation: Independent commercial/owner review if dispute or contractual consequences; no silent deletion

AP-PLATFORM-JOB.required: Scoped platform operator job metadata or specifically approved replay, tenant and job-type allowlists, audit
AP-PLATFORM-JOB.separation: No global customer business-data access; replay cannot bypass domain authorization

separationOfDuties.conflict: Commercial price/terms exception requester cannot approve same exception
Payment initiator cannot approve same payment
Tenant Admin cannot grant own or others' nondelegable permissions
separationOfDuties.mechanism: permission subset delegationCeiling and no owner/platform assignment

separationOfDuties.conflict: Provider staff cannot accept customer quote or write customer review by provider role alone
Platform support/super-admin cannot read tenant business records by global designation
separationOfDuties.mechanism: separate approved just-in-time support workflow if ever required

separationOfDuties.conflict: Company owner cannot be last owner deleted without accepted successor

dataPolicies.supplierRates: Provider-owned buy rate confidential to authorized Procurement/Finance; never Customer or carrier-other than own offer
dataPolicies.customerPrice: Customer-facing accepted quote visible only authorized customer/org and provider commercial actors
dataPolicies.location: Driver/vehicle coordinates require assignment or explicit projection grant; tracking freshness + privacy filters
dataPolicies.documents: Server-side rights rechecked at read/download; signed URL revocation limited by issuance TTL unless proxy
dataPolicies.reviews: Private attributable service feedback after verified delivery; provider response append-only later; no public ratings in R0
dataPolicies.audit: Denied high-risk operations audited without exposing full personal data or secrets
